senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. טוּף, טָפַף II)to wash, rinse.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 11:6">Zeb. XI, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Zevachim 94b:14">94ᵇ</cite>) <he>ושׁוֹטְפוֹ</he>, v. <cite ref="M02760"><he>מָרַק</he></cite>; Tosef. ib. X, 13 <he>ושׁוֹטְפָן</he>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Chullin 10:4">Tosef. Ḥull. X, 4</cite> <he>השׁוֹטֵף רחיליו חייב וכ׳</he> if one washes his lambs (in place of clipping), he is bound to give the priest’s share of the wool (that they shed); <cite ref="Chullin 137a">Ḥull. 137ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="U00736"><he>שָׁטוּף</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Shabbat 99a">Sabb. 99ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 35:26">Ex. XXXV, 26</cite>) <he>ש׳ בעזים וטווו בעזים</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>מן העזים</he>) the hair was washed on the goats and spun on the goats; ib. 74ᵇ; Yalk. Ex. 370.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 8:5">B. Mets. VIII, 5</cite> <he>ש׳ נהר זיתיו וכ׳</he> if a stream carried off one’s olive-trees and deposited them in a neighbor’s field.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 10:4">B. Kam. X, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Kamma 115b:2">115ᵇ</cite>) <he>ש׳ נהר חמורו וכ׳</he> (Bab. ed. <he>נחל</he>) if a stream (ravine) carried off his own and his neighbor’s ass …, and he let go his own and saved his neighbor’s. Ib. 5 (117ᵇ) <he>שְׁטָפָהּ נהר</he> if the river washed it (the unlawfully taken field) away.
<cite ref="Yoma 78a">Yoma 78ᵃ</cite> <he>נחל שׁוֹטֵף</he> a swiftly running brook.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 1:1:12">Y. Shek. I, 46ᵃ</cite> <he>ירד שֶׁטֶף … ושְׁטָפוֹ</he> a rain shower came down and washed it (the mark on the grave) off. Y. B. Mets. VIII, end, 11ᵈ <he>בששְׁטָפָן</he> (not <he>בששטן</he>), v. <cite ref="C00502"><he>גּוּשׁ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 24">Ex. R. s. 24</cite> <he>נתמלא … ובקש לשׁוֹטְפָן</he> the genius of the sea became wroth against them, and wanted to drown them.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 19">Num. R. s. 19<sup>9</sup></cite> <he>ויצאו מים רבים ושָׁטְפוּ כל וכ׳</he> many waters came forth, and flooded all those who murmured; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 23:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXVIII, 20</cite> (corr. acc.); a. fr.—V. <cite ref="U00736"><he>שָׁטוּף</he></cite>.

Taan. 6ᵃ ומַשְׁטִיף את הזרעים (Ms. M. ששׁוֹטֵף, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) it (the heavy rain) washes the seeds away; Yalk. Joel 535 ומְשַׁטֵּף (Pi.).—Part. pass. מוּשְׁטָף; pl. מוּשְׁטָפִים carried off, floating. Ex. R. l. c. לפי שראו … מ׳ על פני המים because they saw the bodies … floating on the water.

senses.gloss: to be washed, showered upon; to take a shower bath.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 40a:7">Sabb. 40ᵃ</cite> <he>ויוצא ומִשְׁתַּטַּף וכ׳</he> and goes out (of the steam-room), and takes a shower bath in the outer room. Ib.ᵇ <he>ובלבד שלא יִשְׁתַּטֵּף וכ׳</he> but he must not have a cold shower bath and then warm himself &c. Tosef. ib. III (IV), 4; a. fr.

Sifré Deut. 307 מה ראו … שנִשְׁטְפוּ במים why were the men of the flood drowned in water?; Yalk. ib. 942 שיִשָּׁטְפוּ; Sifré l. c. מה … להִשְׁתַּטֵּף באש וכ׳ why were the men of Sodom … swept away by fire and sulphur?; Yalk. l. c. להִשָּׁטֵף; a. e.—Trnsf. to be carried away by passion.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9">Num. R. s. 9<sup>17</sup></cite>; <cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 12:1">Sifré Num. 12</cite> <he>הרבה קידמוך ונִשְׁטְפוּ</he> many women before thee have been carried away (into infidelity).
